keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Oussama Targhalline, Feyenoord. Feyenoord 0, FC Porto 1.
Victor Froholdt (FC Porto) is shown the yellow card.

Gonçalo Borges (Feyenoord) is shown the yellow card.
